select
	sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 as avg_yearly
from
	lineitem,
	part
where
	p_partkey = l_partkey
	and p_brand = 'Brand#23'
	and p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
	and l_quantity < (
		select
			0.2 * avg(l_quantity)
		from
			lineitem
		where
			l_partkey = p_partkey
	)
limit 1;

WITH avg_qty AS (
  SELECT l_partkey, avg(l_quantity) AS avg_qty
  FROM lineitem
  GROUP BY l_partkey
)
SELECT sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem li
JOIN part p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN avg_qty aq ON li.l_partkey = aq.l_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
  AND li.l_quantity < 0.2 * aq.avg_qty
LIMIT 1;

FROM lineitem li
JOIN part p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey

    SELECT l_partkey, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
) aq ON li.l_partkey = aq.l_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
  AND li.l_quantity < 0.2 * aq.avg_qty;

    SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * avg(l_quantity) AS qty_threshold
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
)

FROM lineitem l
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN avg_qty a ON a.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
  AND l.l_quantity < a.qty_threshold
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(li.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem li
JOIN part p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN (
    SELECT l_partkey, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
) aq ON li.l_partkey = aq.l_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
  AND li.l_quantity < 0.2 * aq.avg_qty;

WITH avg_qty AS (
    SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * avg(l_quantity) AS qty_threshold
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
)
SELECT sum(l.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem l
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN avg_qty a ON a.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
  AND l.l_quantity < a.qty_threshold
LIMIT 1;

    FROM lineitem

WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
  AND l.l_quantity < a.qty_threshold
LIMIT 1;

select
	sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 as avg_yearly
from
	lineitem,
	part
where
	p_partkey = l_partkey
	and p_brand = 'Brand#23'
	and p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
	and l_quantity < (
		select
			0.2 * avg(l_quantity)
		from
			lineitem
		where
			l_partkey = p_partkey
	)
limit 1;

select
	sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 as avg_yearly
from
	lineitem,
	part
where
	p_partkey = l_partkey
	and p_brand = 'Brand#25'
	and p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
	and l_quantity < (
		select
			0.2 * avg(l_quantity)
		from
			lineitem
		where
			l_partkey = p_partkey
	)
limit 1;

select * from emp
where EXISTS (
  select * from emp e where emp.deptno = e.deptno)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  select * from emp ee where ee.job = emp.job AND ee.sal=34);

select * from (values (30, 3)) as t (x, y)
where x > 30
except
select * from (values (20, 2)) as t (x, y)
except
select * from (values (40, 4)) as t (x, y);

select sal from emp
where empno NOT IN (
  select deptno from dept
  where emp.job = dept.name);

select * from
(select NAME, DEPTNO, count(*) over (partition by NAME) from dept) t
where DEPTNO = 0

select empno > ANY (
  select deptno from dept where emp.job = dept.name)
from emp

select sal from emp where empno IN (
  select deptno from dept where emp.job = dept.name)

select * from emp
where sal = 4
or empno NOT IN (select deptno from dept)

select * from emp e1
  where e1.empno > SOME (select deptno from dept)

select e.job,
  min(sal) as min_sal, min(e.deptno) as min_deptno,
  sum(sal) + 1 as sum_sal_plus, max(sal) as max_sal,
  sum(sal) as sum_sal_2, count(sal) as count_sal,
  count(mgr) as count_mgr
from emp as e
join dept as d on e.job = d.name
group by e.job,d.name
select empno from emp where empno>10 and empno<=10

select empno, sum(sal), min(sal), max(sal),
 bit_and(distinct sal), bit_or(sal), count(distinct sal),
 grouping(deptno)
from emp
group by empno, deptno
select empno, count(mgr) from emp group by empno, deptno

select * from emp where empno > ANY (

select empno from emp where empno=10 and empno is null

select empno from emp
where empno=10 and not(empno=10)
select sum(distinct deptno), count(distinct deptno), max(deptno) from emp

select deptno c, min(y), max(z) z,
sum(r), sum(m) n, sum(x) sal from (
   select deptno, ename, sum(sal) x, max(sal) z,
      min(sal) y, count(hiredate) m, count(mgr) r
   from emp group by deptno, ename) t

select coalesce(sum(count_comm), 0)
from (
